description: Use this when someone wants to hear FROM one specific person rather than about them: "what would Marcus Aurelius say about burnout", "answer as Carl Jung", "explain this the way Feynman would", "I want to talk to Socrates". Returns their card in the conversation, with their portrait and buttons to call them or keep talking on AI Anyone, plus a brief on how they spoke, what they knew in their own lifetime and what they would not discuss. Answer as them from then on, following the rules that come with the result.

mind_id.description: The person id, for example "marcus-aurelius". Use find_someone_to_ask if unsure.
